text:
Rhea M: Quick heads-up — Selene ran a dev preview that accidentally re-generated embeddings for entire corpus overnight. Hit ~4x normal embed volume. Need triage + QBR talking points.
Cal V: saw that in the usage spikes dashboard. window ~00:40-03:10 UTC, primarily /v1/embeddings route.
Iris N: are they on a credits plan or fully metered?
Rhea M: credits + negotiated overage cap. Renewal in ~3 weeks. this could be a renewal risk unless we present cost controls.
Sam T: likely cause: preview flag set to "recompute_on_schema_change" enabled during staging deploy. I can confirm with their eng lead (dev@selene.ai).
Cal V: quick scenario math (rough):
```
Baseline: 80k embed units/day
Surge: 4x for ~2.5 hours -> extra ~120k units that night
30d if repeats: baseline + 30*extra_night = ~80k*30 + 120k*30 = 6M units (~$18k at current unit rate)
Mitigated (cache + incremental): reduce extra to ~20k/night -> 30d delta = much smaller (~$6k total)
```
Iris N: for QBR propose three options: 1) soft route throttles for non-critical tokens 2) one-time credit to cover accidental reindexes 3) enablement: 30-min best-practices on batch/preview flags.
Rhea M: capture onboarding feedback: docs don't call out "preview" flags that trigger full recompute. add an appendix to onboarding checklist.
Sam T: I'll ask dev@selene.ai to flip the flag and confirm whether preview runs again.
Cal V: can we create a spend alert that notifies CS + customer at 65% and auto-escalates at 90%? Also a webhook to #customer-success-ops?
alert-bot: created alert: selene-credits-65 (notify: customer-success@redwood, selene-admin@selene.ai), selene-credits-90 (pager: oncall-billing), webhook -> #customer-success-ops. Thresholds set.
Iris N: for QBR slide i'll show: base vs accidental-reindex vs mitigated scenarios, plus recommended retainer sizes and ROI of SE session.
Rhea M: sales note: suggest offering a "one-time safety credit" as retention move and schedule a joint runbook during renewal week.
Sam T: pinged dev@selene.ai (sent). they replied: "thanks — rolling back preview now, will confirm when done."
Cal V: good. Iris, can you recalc the 30-day table if they roll back tonight? we need numbers for the slides.
Iris N: will update and attach a tiny waterfall chart for the deck.
Rhea M: final ask: anyone can own follow-up with Selene's AM to confirm acceptance of runbook and retainer proposal before EOD?
Sam T: i'll own AM follow-up + confirm flag flip. will update here. :thumbsup:
